title: The fitness landscape of the E.coli lac operator is highly rugged in two different environments
authors: Chattopadhyay G; Papkou A; Wagner A
one_liner_zh: 该文通过CRISPR与高通量测序绘制lac操纵子适应度景观，聚焦序列-适应度关系而非TF-DNA互作建模，缺乏AI或物理模拟方法，仅边缘相关。
abstract: We know little about the fitness landscapes of bacterial operators, regulatory DNA elements that are crucial to regulate metabolic genes like those of the lac operon for lactose utilization. For example, we do not know whether adaptive evolution could easily create strong operators from weak ones or from non-regulatory DNA. To find out, we used CRISPR-Cas-assisted genome editing, bulk competition, and high-throughput sequencing to map the fitness landscape of more than 140,000 lac operator variants in two chemical environments that harbor lactose or glycerol as sole carbon sources. Both landscapes are highly rugged and contain thousands of fitness peaks, which allow only 2 percent of evolving populations to reach a high fitness peak. The landscapes share only 15 percent of fitness peaks. Our work illustrates that landscape ruggedness caused by epistasis can represent an important obstacle to adaptive evolution of regulatory sequences. It also shows that a simple environmental change can substantially affect fitness landscape topography.
abstract_zh: 我们对细菌操纵子的适应度景观知之甚少，这些调控DNA元件对于调节代谢基因（如乳糖利用的lac操纵子）至关重要。例如，我们不清楚适应性进化是否能轻易地将弱操纵子或非调控DNA转化为强操纵子。为探究此问题，我们利用CRISPR-Cas辅助基因组编辑、批量竞争和高通量测序技术，在含有乳糖或甘油作为唯一碳源的两种化学环境中，绘制了超过140,000个lac操纵子变体的适应度景观。这两个景观均高度崎岖，包含数千个适应度峰，但仅允许2%的进化群体达到高适应度峰。两个景观仅共享15%的适应度峰。我们的工作表明，由上位效应引起的景观崎岖性可能构成调控序列适应性进化的重要障碍，同时也揭示简单的环境变化能显著影响适应度景观的地形特征。
